description: Australian-built Avon Sabre that served Skadron Udara 14, Wing 300 at Lanud Iswahjudi from 1973 to 1981; transferred from Lanud Abdulrachman Saleh and unveiled on 31 December 2022 east of the Soeprijadi statue. A detik.com listing places it on the Blitar alun-alun instead; the TNI-AU announcement placing it at Museum PETA is preferred.
